Local Team Wins Championship

By Jane Reporter

The Denver Larks defeated the Riverton Ravens 3-2 in overtime on Sunday night, claiming their first championship in fifteen years. The sold-out crowd erupted as the winning goal sailed past the keeper with ninety seconds remaining.

Larks captain Marta Vela called it the biggest moment of her career.

The team will hold a victory parade downtown next weekend, city officials confirmed Monday.
